name: robots/maniparena__maniparena-sim
title: ManipArena-Sim (Isaac Lab / IsaacLab-Arena bimanual simulation)
intro: ManipArena-Sim (Isaac Lab / IsaacLab-Arena bimanual simulation), adapted from maniparena/maniparena-sim. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset_world` and `set_seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
